title.narrative: Capital Markets Development Trust Fund by AfDB (CMDTF) 2024-2026
Capital Markets Development Trust Fund by AfDB (CMDTF) 2024-2026

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the CMDTF is to promote the establishment of well-functioning capital markets in Africa that effectively mobilize and allocate resources to meet the financing needs of the private and public sectors. To achieve this goal, the CMDTF plans to:
i) Improve the regulatory and legal environment of capital markets;
(ii) upgrading the infrastructure of capital markets
(iii) diversify available products
(iv) broaden the investor base; and
v) Increase knowledge of African capital markets.

The report highlights several accomplishments, the most important expected results achieved include: - completion of 54% of planned deliverables, operationalization of the WAMU digital issuance platform, delivery of major regulatory reforms and market development strategies, training of 1,128 professionals, including 40% women, development of SME finance, housing finance, and savings mobilization strategies.
The most notable unexpected results include: -
exceptionally high demand for CMDTF support (USD 55.5 million in requests), higher than target female participation, enhanced visibility and recognition of CMDTF, emergence of strong regional integration opportunities, generation of a robust pipeline for Phase II and future scaling up initiatives.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
